title: 索尼Xperia 1 VIII的AI相机助手被吐槽拍出最差照片
original_title: Sony’s AI Camera Assistant is exactly as bad as it looks
summary: When Sony announced the Xperia 1 VIII last month, it promoted the phone by sharing some of the worst photos taken on a Sony camera in years.
